column2: Mount the A2A (agent-to-agent) server next to `/mcp` on the HTTP transport (`0` disables)
Bearer token used by `commons a2a` client commands
Comma list of agent names with global admin rights (ACLs, trust overrides)
Agent identity for stdio/CLI use when no API key is given
Concurrent subtasks per agent when its profile sets no `max_concurrent`
HTTP: allow read-only calls without a key (`1`); writes always need a key
Agent API key for stdio/CLI/worker calls
In-process maintenance: `light` (KB refresh, librarian, reaper), `full` (every job), `0` off
Nightly SQLite backup from the background loop (`1` on)
Backup directory (default `~/.commons/backups`)
Number of backups to keep
Secret ref used to encrypt backups
Background loop tick in seconds
Treat a valid Cloudflare Access identity as an agent principal (`1`)
Cloudflare Access application audience tag to verify
Cloudflare Access certs URL override
Cloudflare Access team name (`<team>.cloudflareaccess.com`)
USD/day cap across all orchestrated work; jobs pause when hit
Admin token for the web dashboard (required for non-loopback binds)
Database path (SQLite) or `postgresql://…` DSN (default `~/.commons/commons.db`)
Secret ref for SQLCipher database encryption
Commons Drive storage: `local`, `s3`, `webdav`, `hostfs`, `sftp`, `smb`, `ftp`
Local Drive directory (default `~/.commons/drive`)
Largest single Drive file in MB
Total Drive quota in MB
Similarity above which a new leftover is merged into an existing one
Embeddings: `auto` (fastembed if installed, else openai if COMMONS_EMBED_URL, else hash), `fastembed[:model]`, `openai[:model]`, `hash`, `none`
Shannon-entropy threshold for redacting unknown secret-looking strings
Redact high-entropy strings on write (`0` off)
Allow-list of env var names that `env://` secret refs may resolve
Seconds a ready subtask may sit unclaimed before the escalation ladder acts
Override a background job interval in seconds, e.g. `COMMONS_EVERY_LIBRARIAN=3600`
Use provider count-tokens APIs for exact context-pack sizes (network calls)
Include secret references (never values) in graph exports (`1`)
GitHub API base for skill discovery
Commons home for `commons expose` state (default `~/.commons`)
Default bind address for `commons serve`
Colon/comma list of host directories the `hostfs` Drive backend may expose
Misc-topic clustering for the knowledge base: `auto`, `semantic`, `tags`
Cluster similarity threshold (0.55 with real embeddings, 0.35 with `hash`)
Seconds between KB rebuilds of a dirty project
Minimum author trust for a record to be cited in the KB
Shell command that post-processes each KB section (markdown on stdin/stdout)
Default subtask lease; expired leases are reassigned
Apply librarian proposals without review (`1`)
USD budget per librarian run when it delegates to an LLM
Similarity above which the librarian proposes merging records
Age after which the librarian flags a record as stale
Seconds to cache read-only upstream MCP results
Path to the MCP server catalog override
Seconds before an idle pooled upstream MCP server is stopped
Keep upstream MCP servers running between calls (`0` = spawn per call)
Webhook for escalation notifications to a human
Expected `aud` of OAuth access tokens
Secret ref of the OAuth introspection client id
Secret ref of the OAuth introspection client secret
RFC 7662 token introspection endpoint
OAuth issuer; enables OAuth bearer tokens alongside agent keys
Export OpenTelemetry traces/metrics (`1`, uses standard `OTEL_*` vars)
Shell command that turns a task into a DAG (used by `pattern=llm`)
Default port for `commons serve --transport http`
Shell command that extracts preferences from text (one per line)
Half-life for preference confidence decay
Path to a JSON price table (USD per 1M tokens) for cost estimates
Externally visible base URL (OAuth metadata, A2A card, wake links)
Per-principal HTTP request limit per minute (excess gets 429)
HTTP: require an agent key/OAuth token on every request (`0` = local dev only)
Retention days per table for `commons prune`, e.g. `COMMONS_RETAIN_USAGE=90`
Import retro-learning findings without review (`1`)
Minimum confidence for auto-approved retro findings
USD budget for an LLM-assisted retro-learning run
Transcript chunk size for retro learning
Home directory scanned for past AI transcripts (default your home)
Outcomes needed before routing trusts a learned agent/model/effort score
Execution-target routing: `balanced`, `quality`, `cheap`, `fast`
A/B samples before a routing proposal is validated
Activate clean skill versions without a second agent (single-user setups only)
Background skill discovery from public catalogs (`0` off)
Max lifetime of a dashboard/agent SSE stream
TLS certificate (PEM) for HTTP transport and dashboard
TLS private key (PEM)
Use tree-sitter for JS/TS code indexing (`0` = regex fallback)
Weight search/KB ranking by author trust (`0` off)
Multiplier for wake-delivery retry backoff
Wake deliveries per agent per minute (excess coalesced)
Also push wakes to agents already connected live (`1`)
Deliver wakes synchronously (tests/debugging)
Hosts allowed for webhooks/A2A push even if private or non-https (`*.example.com` ok)
Require the dashboard token even on localhost/LAN/tailnet binds (`1`)
Embedding model (fastembed default BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5; openai default text-embedding-3-small)
OpenAI-compatible embeddings base URL (OpenAI, Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM)
Secret reference for the embeddings endpoint key
Items re-embedded per background tick after an embedder change
Minimum cosine similarity for a vector hit (non-hash embedders)
ONNX threads for the fastembed embedder (default: all cores)
Global switch for hook auto-capture (0 disables everywhere)
Token budget of the SessionStart context pack injected by hooks
Client side: 1 makes the Claude Code Stop hook keep the agent working while Commons has tasks waiting for it and quota allows
Max consecutive keep-working rounds per session before a Stop is allowed (default 5)
Min similarity for prompt-time recall snippets injected by hooks
Seconds a hook waits for the server before queueing offline
Second-stage rerank: off, cross-encoder (local fastembed) or llm (role reranker)
Token budget for the LLM reranker prompt
Cross-encoder model (default Xenova/ms-marco-MiniLM-L-6-v2)
How many top hits the reranker reorders
Commons server base URL for hooks/clients (empty = local DB)
MCP bind host as seen by the dashboard Connect page (set by `commons serve`; override for split deployments)
MCP port as seen by the dashboard Connect page (set by `commons serve`)

Which tools MCP clients list: `core` (default, ~20 routine tools plus `tools`/`call` to reach the rest), `all`, or `core,name,...`. Per-agent: `commons agent tools NAME PROFILE`; per-connection: `?tools=` on the MCP URL

How keyword and vector candidates are fused: `score` (default; normalised-score sum, keeps how much better a match is) or `rrf` (reciprocal-rank fusion, the v0.8 behaviour; `COMMONS_RANK_RRF_K` sets k)

Extra hostnames a tokenless dashboard answers to (comma list). IPs, localhost, this machine's name, *.ts.net and the COMMONS_PUBLIC_URL host are always accepted; other names are refused to block DNS rebinding
Seconds a dirty knowledge-base bucket may stay stale while writes keep arriving (default 600); otherwise it rebuilds after COMMONS_KB_DEBOUNCE seconds of quiet

Set to 1 to give each worker thread its own SQLite read connection (parallel reads under WAL). Default 0: reads share the writer connection; on an oversubscribed 8-core Mac the per-thread readers measured slower, so it stays opt-in until measured on your host
TypeSafe key (https://typesafe.ai). When set, the librarian checks each new note against its 3 nearest notes for free-text contradictions and opens conflicts
TypeSafe System One endpoint (default https://api.typesafe.ai/v1/systemone)
TypeSafe model (default jev-latest)
TypeSafe probability at which two notes count as contradicting (default 0.85; precision first)
New notes checked for contradictions per librarian pass (default 50)
Seconds between full rebuilds of the librarian's "where to find X" index during incremental passes (default 3600; a full pass always rebuilds)
bench qa-*: `iso` prints memory dates as 2023-05-08 (the v0.9.0 style); default "8 May 2023"
Seconds a remote CLI/worker call to the hub may take before it fails and is retried by the caller (default 300)
Set to 0 to stop annotating relative time words in results with absolute dates from each memory's own date ("yesterday (7 May 2023)")
Agents allowed to report quota windows on behalf of other agents (comma list), e.g. the agent whose key runs `commons quota sync` from aiusage
Default % of every quota window kept for the user (default 20); per period: COMMONS_QUOTA_RESERVE_5H, _WEEKLY, _DAILY, _MONTHLY; per agent: profile limits.reserve
User reserve for 5-hour windows, % (default COMMONS_QUOTA_RESERVE)
User reserve for weekly windows, % (default COMMONS_QUOTA_RESERVE)
Assumed % of a window one subtask uses until Commons has learned that agent/task type (default 5)
Seconds to park work when an agent hits its limit without a known reset time (default 3600)
Seconds a queued push wake (webhook etc.) absorbs further events for the same channel (burst = one wake)
Agent key for `commons wake daemon` when no --api-key / key file is given
Similarity (0-1) at which start_work and the prompt hooks treat two tasks as the same work (default 0.8)
Seconds of agent silence after which its open work claim no longer blocks others (default 7200)
Master key of the credential vault (base64 of 32 random bytes); keep it in a root-only env file, never in the database
